description: This file defines the Timeslotter class, which manages a collection of timeslots and provides methods to categorize notes based on their modification date, primarily for display purposes in an Android app.

classes.name: Timeslotter
classes.description: A utility class for managing timeslots and categorizing notes based on their modification timestamps.

methods.name: Timeslotter
methods.description: Constructor initializing timeslots relative to the current date and preparing a reference to the previous year.

methods.name: getTimeslot
methods.description: Returns a string label for a note, indicating when it was last modified relative to the current date, week, or year.
